responsibility: This header defines the `cortexa72_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-A72 in the AArch64 backend. It reuses Cortex-A57 extra-cost, regmove, and vector-cost components but provides its own `tune_params` bundle for issue rate, fusion behavior, alignments, and policy flags, allowing the backend to treat Cortex-A72 as a distinct tuning target while sharing closely related cost substructures.
